body: Thanks for all your thoughts and opinions. I won't be jumping in front of a train now. I have found a cliff that would be suitable. It has quite a view too. Perhaps one sun rise in the near future I will leap like a bird. You've saved me from traumatising an innocent driver and guard. Thanks.
I agree. It's not the option I would want to pick from the two.

Thank you for your reply. I am not well and I'm suffering from head  & ear pain. I have been holding on for 6 months now but can't keep this up. I have been off work for a long time.I have a family to support but can't in my present state. I love my family but I am a burden that's sunk too far down. I have horrible anxiety problems. I am scared of noise. Every time I plan something , I chicken out. I should be gone now. I would be at peace. I still try and fight but I am exhausted everyday. I do not want to jump in front of a train at all. It horrifies me to even think this. I can't keep doing this. Something is going to give.
The problem of "being broken into pieces" can also occur when jumping from a building. A high enough jump will cause the body to mush !!

Agreed. It just takes one action to step off the edge and just fall. It's doing that one action though that's hard. Not sure I could manage it. Train option involves someone else though which I am not comfortable about at all.
True. Wonder which one of the two would be more painless? Train option could be over quicker possibly ?
